name: G6/G7: data-mb-dp-newtab ignored in a window (Discogs credits)
why: G6 of NON-MB-COVERAGE.org: without the marker's check, "All credits on Discogs ↗" reopens the same artist in the window.

name: G6/G7: data-mb-dp-newtab ignored in a window (Wikipedia table)
why: G7: without the marker's check, the table's link spelled unlike the window's reopens the same article in the window.

name: G6: the credits link without the marker
why: G6: the Discogs artist window's credits link must carry data-mb-dp-newtab.

name: G7: the table link without the marker
why: G7: the Wikipedia window's table link must carry data-mb-dp-newtab.

name: G8: a Discogs window drills nothing before its record
why: G8: before the record has arrived, a link in a Discogs window must open in the window.

name: G3: a Brucebase show link on Brucebase is the page's own again
why: G3: in a window on brucebase.wikidot.com, /<yyyy>#<ddmmyy> must be the bbdate reader's despite the same host.

name: G3: the exception reaches the page itself too
why: G3 is for links IN a window: on the page itself such a link stays the site's own.

name: G2: MusicBrainz windows on discogs.com and setlist.fm only
why: G2: on the Springsteen sites and archive.org a musicbrainz.org link in a window opens MusicBrainz's window (vzell's consent, 2026-11-03).

name: G5: dg-mb names #app only
why: G5: an importer icon in Discogs' older layout (#page_content) must have MusicBrainz's card before a render.

name: G4: discogs.com without <main>
why: G4: the search page's results are in <main>; without it in extRoot nothing previews before a render.

name: G4: setlist.fm's extRoot our own section only
why: G4: setlist.fm's own list (.setlistPreview, .info) must preview before a render.

name: G4: setlist.fm's relative links not read against the page
why: G4: setlist.fm writes its Tour links relative ("../search?…"); unread, they preview nothing.

name: G4: archive.org's relative links not read against the page
why: G4: archive.org writes its result links relative ("/details/<id>"); unread, they preview nothing.

name: G4: archive.org's events read at the shadow host
why: G4: without composedPath() the document's listener sees only <app-root>, never the result's link.

name: G4: no mousemove tracking inside archive.org's shadow DOM
why: G4: a mouseout inside <app-root> never reaches the document, so without mousemove the card never hides on leaving the link.

name: G4: archive.org's navigation previewed
why: G4: <ia-topnav> and the plain nav/header/footer are skipped; a collection link there must show no card.

name: G4: archive.org's link scope not checked
why: G4: archive.org's selector takes any a[href] (shadow DOM has no root selector); _iaShadowLinkInScope() is what keeps its navigation out.

name: G4: a text-less shadow link (a picture, a tile) previewed
why: vzell, 2026-11-04: our card came on top of archive.org's own hover card over a result's picture and a tile.
